hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/silver-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Each site offers water and electric hook-ups with recently upgraded 50-amp service') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 53 web-bookable sites 50-amp electric and water; 12 list Sewer Hookup: Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 59 sites in two loops (Fort King, Sharpes Ferry); 53 are bookable online, 12 of them with sewer. Online sites take 50 ft (four 38 ft); 22 are pull-through. Sites 20 and 53 are fully accessible.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/silver-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('59 spacious sites in two campground loops ... with a maximum recreational vehicle length of 50 feet', 'Sites 20 and 53 are fully accessible') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facilities 169-172 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/silver-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('A separate dump station for holding tanks is located in the park', 'Laundry facilities are available in the campgrounds for registered campers', 'sidewalks leading to both of the campground bathhouses'; Shower Station: 'Access to showers for bathing may be purchased at the ranger station for those who are not camping'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/silver-springs-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks' reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

note: Two campground loops, Fort King and Sharpes Ferry, in pines and oaks about a mile from the head spring. Pets are allowed in the campground but not in the cabin area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 59 sites, 50-amp water/electric (12 also sewer on the booking site), to 50 ft with pull-throughs, dump station, laundry, bathhouses, reservable.
